title: Skip-Pass Long Closeout
description: A help-side defender sitting in the lane must cover a long distance to close out on a skip pass to the corner, arriving under control and still able to contain the drive.

content.objective: Recover from deep help position on a skip pass, covering eight metres fast but arriving balanced enough to stop the drive.
content.setup: Passer at the right wing; shooter in the left corner; defender in help position in the lane (two passes away).
instructions: The defender starts in help position on the lane line, pointing at the ball and the corner shooter.
The passer throws an overhead skip pass to the left corner.
Sprint while the ball is in the air; start chopping the feet one-third of the way from the shooter.
Arrive with a high hand and the inside foot forward to force baseline.
Play live: contain the drive or contest the shot.
coachingPoints: Leave on the pass, not on the catch.
Take away the middle drive: force baseline toward help.
commonMistakes: Flying past the shooter because the chop started late.
Arriving square and giving up the middle.
content.safety: Defenders close out under control and never land on the shooter's feet.
progressions: Add a second shooter who relocates.
variations: Two-person closeout game with X-out rotation.
content.gameApplication: Skip passes beat help defense; long closeouts decide whether the corner three is open or contested.
